Method of Attack: Use of valid code-signing certificate to sign malware
Embedding malware into legitimate library (e.g. colorui.dll)
Execution with elevated privileges via rundll32 command
Dormant period to evade sandbox analysis
Decryption and execution of embedded payloads (Cobalt Strike and BitRAT)
Persistence via copies in ProgramData folder and startup location
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of rundll32.exe, explorer.exe, ProgramData folder)
Attack Vector: Malware signed with valid certificate to evade detection
Malware embedded in legitimate DLL library
Indicators of Compromise: Signed and unsigned Blister loader samples
Use of code-signing certificate issued by Sectigo for Blist LLC
Email address from Russian provider Mail.Ru
Persistence in ProgramData folder and startup entries
Payloads include Cobalt Strike and BitRAT
